records.issue_text: Salesforce refreshes directly against Salesforce without calling refreshOAuthTokens, so CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT has no effect.
records.rationale: Looking at packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts in the diff, the Salesforce integration directly calls fetch() to refresh tokens without wrapping it in refreshOAuthTokens(). Other integrations like Google Calendar, Office365, Zoom, Webex, etc. all wrap their refresh token calls with refreshOAuthTokens() to support the CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT feature.
